text: CPW is a private sector business which has many objectives. It sells electrical goods including
kettles and ovens in its 36 shops in country X. CPW also offers a delivery service. The business
buys all its inventory from local suppliers to avoid import tariffs. The Finance Director is analysing
CPW’s statement of financial position. An extract is shown in Table 2.1. He has been asked to find
a source of finance to purchase 10 new delivery vehicles.

text: MTL is a large business which sells children’s toys. MTL wants to act ethically with all of its
stakeholder groups including its 430 employees. The market MTL operates in has become more
competitive. The business uses a range of methods to promote its products. Having a good brand
image is important. MTL’s directors are considering entering a new market in another country. They
are aware there may be problems if they choose to do this.
